en: Colorized historic postcard view of a landscaped park with winding gravel paths, flowerbeds, a central fountain jet, and several people in early 20th‑century clothing strolling along the paths. In the background, partly hidden by tall trees, stands an ornate historicist building with mansard roofs, a tower and cupola. The sky is light blue with a few clouds. Red German captions are printed at the top: the left side names the location, and the right describes the park scene.
